notes.title: Update - Patch 1.0.10
notes.content:
Hello riders! Patch 1.0.10 is here. Based on your feedback following the game's release, it improves gameplay, fixes various bugs and adds PlayStation controller support on PC. Thanks again for your feedback, which helps us improve the game every day! 🤘



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/74c18d881be87d5ca9fd31bad85a0252cac149ea.jpg"]


Changelog 
Fixed the issue where the QR code for the manga was still shown in the options menu.

Fixed the issue where selecting the tab icons dots with the mouse when in the option menu (coming from the main menu) would make the "back" button stop working and by pressing ESC it would show the in game menu, locking the player.

Fixed an issue with how the component stats bonus is shown in the hexagonal stats chart (the bonus it the one in yellow, activated by having component all of the same design or all of different design). This bonus wouldn't scale visually with the scale shown by the hexagonal chart, now they are scaled accordingly.

Added SPACE BAR as a "confirm" input (in addition to mouse LMB).

Added ESC as main "back" input (in addition to RMB, but now it shows the icon for esc in the interfaces).

Added ESC as main "hold to exit" button (in addition to RMB, but now it shows the icon for esc in the interfaces). Used in situations like skipping short cutscenes or leaving the extra section.

Now skipping the use/leave workbench cutscene uses the same "hold to exit" button as the rest of similar situations (which is now ESC). Before it only used LMB.

Inside TABs with hexagonal scrollers (hoverboard components, materials in the crafting tab, customization, designs) now the user can move horizontally and vertically to a different component, material etc. by clicking on it with the mouse LMB (in addition to using WASD).

The when opening the menu during play will place the mouse at the center of the screen instead of the top left for better usability.

Fixed issue that prevented unlocking the "Ride with style" achievement, when collecting all the hoverboard styles.

Fixed issue that didn't show the correct number of max available styles in the customization section of the workbench.

Added a sound effect for the platform devices (inside mines) that move based on the position of the player on the platform itself.

Now when doing races a second time after winning once will have the time time added with ring reduced from 20s to 15s.

In the Lambda mine, the initial one with a cross made of rails at the start and a cart in the middle, it was possible to activate the doors by using the wheels even if the cart wasn't close to the wheels. There where also 2 duplicate d4 lasers that have been removed (the only lasers that should be available are the ones generated by pressing the buttons).

We have added direct support for Playstation controller on PC, with the correct icons appearing. This requires Steam input to be disabled to test it.

notes.title: Meet Bios in Star Overdrive 🎸
notes.content:
Let’s talk about the heart of Star Overdrive: Bios, our main character on this cosmic journey.
If you've played the demo which is available now, you've already caught a glimpse of him, now it's time to meet him!

His mission 🛹
Bios is a young man on a mission. After receiving a mysterious signal from his missing girlfriend Nous, he sets off across the galaxy to find her. His destination? The dangerous planet Cebete, where she may be waiting or in danger.

With nothing but Nous’s old Hoverboard and his Keytar, Bios is ready to ride, fight, and play his way through every challenge the universe throws at him.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/6cadbe19ad2e3d7dd602b80fdcc467a0f30da6c7.jpg

Music, Style & Power 🎶 

Bios isn’t your typical space hero he's a gamer, and a die-hard fan of 80s rock legends like Van Halen, AC/DC, and Deep Purple. His keytar isn’t just for show: it’s a weapon, a tool, and a source of power that lets him channel music into combat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/ec41ca8af2a0f4cf8c53d261ae1a1507a5cc7b37.jpg

notes.title: Get ready to customize you Hoverboard! 🛠️
notes.content:
We'd like to introduce you to an important feature of the game: the Hoverboard customization system, and we hope you enjoy it as much as we do!

Have you already started thinking about what your ideal hoverboard will look like? Elegant and minimalist? Colorful and flashy? Something totally out of the ordinary? The choice is yours!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/7b684ac53413612a0b91c467c1f9e624ea62cdc1.gif

What can you customize? 🎨 

    Colors: Choose your own color palette to bring out your personality.
    Components: Collect crafting components to enhance performance and style.
    Designs: Apply designs, lights to make your style unique
    Board Types: Choose from different board shapes, each with its own unique feel.

With so many possibilities, every Hoverboard can look and feel completely different. Whether you're into clean lines or chaotic energy, you’ll be able to create something that truly represents your playstyle.

notes.title: Focus on the Star Overdrive Manga 📖
notes.content:
Less than a month before the release of Star Overdrive! 🪐

The countdown has begun Star Overdrive is just a few weeks away! While we all wait with excitement, let’s talk about the Manga that expands the universe of the game in new and emotional ways. Already available in physical format, it will soon be released digitally on Steam!

About the Manga 📖 

Written by Tommaso Bonanni (also the game’s Creative Director) and illustrated by the talented mangaka Alfredo Postiglione, Star Overdrive - Beyond the Stars is a must-read for fans looking to go deeper into the game's history. 

"We grow up in the 90' so Anime-Manga if for sure one on the source of inspiration, directly of indirectly. The very first concept of Star Overdrive was bord after I saw Eureka 7, incredible anime for visual and style, and they got Hoverboards ofc. You can see a lot of that in Star overdrive, but major part of the world design is inspired by the work of Rofer Dean and Chriss Foss, incredible illustrators from the last century."
Tommaso Bonanni, Creative Director & Writer

notes.title: ⭐ AMA with the devs! ⭐
notes.content:
Here are the answers to our recent AMA, straight from Star Overdrive's lead developer, Tommaso from Caracal Games. He delves into the game's inspirations, mechanics, and even the story behind the manga! 👀


[table noborder=1]

    [tr]

        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/8bb02553661863e5f628c5f446f78a04875c332f.jpg[/th]

        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/a64b41d715c7d1fa05a17828b2c76279aebf9ecb.jpg[/th]

    [/tr]
[/table]

Do you think this game could be fun for someone that enjoys exploration from open worlds but has very limited time? 
We wanted to make a "short" open world, so to complete the game it will only take 10-15 hours instead of 80-100 like other open worlds. We also designed it to be played in short sections with no problems (20-30 minutes maybe? Depends on the player!)

What were the inspirations behind the game? Personally, it gave me strong Trigun vibes.

Trigun, we love it! You know that Bios' hair is the result of some iteration that started from Vash the Stampede? They have a different temper anyway 🙂

We grew up in the '90s, so anime and manga are for sure one of the sources of inspiration, directly or indirectly. The very first concept of Star Overdrive was born after I saw Eureka Seven, an incredible anime in terms of visuals and style—and they’ve got hoverboards, of course. You can see a lot of that in Star Overdrive, but a major part of the world design is inspired by the work of Roger Dean and Chris Foss, incredible illustrators from the last century.

For the music, of course, Van Halen 😉

What's the framerate on the Steam version?
The performance will depend on the hardware running the game. However, Star Overdrive is a very light game, so even on some older machines you should be able to run it very well!

What's the manga about? Is it background info, or a retelling of the plot? I see it available as DLC. Is that the only way to read it?
The manga is a parallel project that we worked on over the past year. We wanted to go a little deeper into the story, taking advantage of this different medium to better show the main character's emotions.

Volume 0 is 180 pages and follows part of the game’s story, but it goes deeper into certain aspects and includes an entire section dedicated to a key prequel event that’s not in the game (only mentioned).

The manga is available as DLC on the e-shop, or you can buy the physical version on Amazon. It's called "Star Overdrive - Beyond the Stars". It's written by me (Tommaso) and illustrated by the awesome Alfredo Postiglione (an Italian mangaka).

Star Overdrive features a unique mix of traversal and combat. How did you balance hoverboard mechanics with enemy encounters to keep gameplay fluid?
Cebete (the planet where Star Overdrive is set) was designed like a giant skate/hoverboard park, with traversal speed in mind. On top of that, we added points of interest for platforming, puzzles, and combat (like mines and towers), as well as activities related to hoverboard riding (like time trials and races). 

The space between these points is kept consistent to ensure you can ride for a bit before reaching the next area of interest. The center of the map is denser with points (since you go slower with the hoverboard there), and the outer areas are more spread out (because you move much faster later in the game).

The really tricky part—which I’m very happy with (I’m also the level designer)—was that we were able to communicate effectively (but indirectly) where the player should ride and where they should explore on foot. Our testers during development, and feedback from the demo, confirmed that it seems to be working well.

What inspired the power-combination system in combat? 
The power system was by far the most difficult—but also the most rewarding—system to develop.

It started, of course, with inspiration from Breath of the Wild’s power system. But since Star Overdrive needed more fast-paced action, we wanted the powers to be more integrated into the combat. You can use powers in combat in BOTW too, but in Star Overdrive, the combat system is based on using powers. They have cumulative effects, not only based on physics, but also on mathematical interactions.

We built the system so that combining powers with enemies, objects, or even the hoverboard always creates a result. During development, we actually discovered several cool mechanics by accident, like the “slingshot,” where you link an enemy/object/hoverboard to two points and then use the grab to charge and throw. It was so fun that we added it into the main quest!

notes.title: 80s inspirations in Star Overdrive 📼
notes.content:
As we count down to the launch of Star Overdrive, we'd like to celebrate one of the game’s biggest inspirations: the unforgettable energy and aesthetic of the 1980s.

The music 🎸
From the moment you strum your Keytar, Star Overdrive channels the retro-futuristic soul of the '80s. One of the major signatures of the 80s is the game's soundtrack! Inspired by the great bands and artists of the era, composer Andréa Federici wanted to immerse us as deeply as possible in 80s rock, drawing inspiration from Van Halen, Deep Purple, Mr. Big and AC/DC.

[table noborder=1]
    [tr]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/a3554c39681f6bbb509813f6d22edb4698259176.png[/th]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/ef7a7ae1f75c433d8e89ba6f8a4c105991ffdc91.png[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/6a5fd98739d02216a8b1c1681a5f54cc349743a2.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/e8d38e678dc60268b433108cc2102a2948a89eb3.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Hoverboards, Keytar, Polaroid and Tapes 📼
Many of the game's mechanics are also linked to the 80s. The main character Bios speeds along on his Hoverboard and performs tricks that defy the laws of gravity, he also fights with his Keytar, and collects tapes and polaroids left by his girlfriend Nous.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/7b684ac53413612a0b91c467c1f9e624ea62cdc1.gif

Whether you’re an '80s kid or just love that timeless synth-powered vibe, Star Overdrive invites you to ride at full speed into nostalgia. Stay tuned for more dev updates, gameplay reveals, and a closer look at what’s waiting for you on Cebete.
